name: claude-code-tatara-workbench
description: Workbench template plugins: a core plugin plus optional packs.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: tooling for any workbench tree (metarepo or flat), dispatched by the superpowers flow: implementer, reviewer, worktree-merger and read-only diagnostic subagents, research skills, worktree, submodule and pull request skills, init, component and template-update skills, verification hooks that tie every test run to the committed HEAD, and destructive-command guardrails.

plugins.name: workbench-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure pack for the workbench template: Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm diagnostic agents and chart drift checks. Requires the workbench core plugin.

plugins.name: workbench-observability
plugins.description: Observability pack for the workbench template: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Kubernetes health diagnostics. Requires the workbench core plugin.

plugins.name: workbench-secrets
plugins.description: Secrets pack for the workbench template: dotenv and SOPS secret handling guardrails. Requires the workbench core plugin.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Development flow forked from superpowers 7.0.0: a plan.md with a scope ladder from MVP to complete, one approval gate that picks the rung, one implementer per chunk, one whole-diff reviewer, at most two fix rounds.
